name: Goyou Kikuzou
source:
Butler of the Oujou family mainly serving [url=/c89921]Maria[/url].
He always puts Maria in the first place, and enjoys considerable confidence from around. However unreasonable requirements put forward, he manages to meet them by making use of money and social network.
